items.title: Mariah Carey brings her signature butterfly motif to Gucci
items.summary: Malaysian business/lifestyle outlet covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine and built around her 'All I Want for Christmas Is You,' introducing the new Butterfly capsule inspired by her 1997 album; framed as a regional retail story ahead of the festive shopping season in Malaysia.

items.title: Park Bo Gum resmi jadi Global Ambassador Gucci - 7 gaya
items.summary: Indonesian national outlet reports Park Bo-gum's move from Celine to Gucci as global brand ambassador, running a styled photo roundup of his looks in the brand's campaigns; coverage is activation-driven and aimed at Indonesia's K-wave-following luxury consumer base.

items.title: BTS Jin as Gucci's global ambassador: his best looks so far
items.summary: Tatler Asia's regional style desk runs a retrospective of BTS Jin's Gucci ambassador looks, timed to the brand's broader November ambassador-refresh wave (Park Bo-gum's appointment); positions Gucci's K-pop/K-drama ambassador strategy as an ongoing engagement lever for Southeast Asia's affluent Hallyu-following audience.

items.title: Thai fan account repost: Billkin at Gucci SS26 Singapore preview
items.summary: Thai Gucci-ambassador fan account (active retweet/engagement thread) recirculates footage and photos of Billkin at the Gucci Marina Bay Sands Spring/Summer preview, part of ongoing organic SNS chatter among Thai and Singaporean fan communities around the brand's regional ambassador activity; representative of sustained fan-driven buzz volume rather than brand-issued content.

items.title: TikTok reaction clips: fans call Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday ad 'depressing,' 'outdated'
items.summary: Aggregated TikTok reaction captured by entertainment press: viewers criticized Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday campaign as cold and joyless, with one comment comparing the ad's luxury styling unfavorably to 'JCPenney trying to be luxury' and others calling the mood 'depressing' and 'outdated'; a critical-angle counterweight to the otherwise celebratory campaign coverage, with visible reach via widely syndicated TikTok-sourced quotes though no public like/comment counts disclosed on the originating posts.

items.title: Gucci Just Won Christmas With a Holiday Campaign Starring Mariah Carey
items.summary: Handbag-collector community site PurseBlog (global reach, read by SEA resale/authentication communities) gives a positive read of the Gucci holiday campaign, praising the Butterfly collection's bag styling; included for balance alongside the TikTok backlash item to show the campaign split opinion even within bag-enthusiast circles, cross-checked against the Butterfly collection facts already confirmed by Business Today Malaysia and NYLON Singapore (pooled 2026-11-09).
